question: I believe that when you were previously asked, “Who does Priscilla rate highly when evaluating other people?”, you answered that Frederica would receive a rating close to the highest possible. Could you tell us why?
answer:
Frederica, and Petra as well, both score highly.

Priscilla likes the type of person who understands their own position and then aims to do 105% of the job.

Frederica and Petra both have ideals that aren't so extreme that they lose sight of their own limitations, while still being capable of doing their jobs properly, so they receive almost the highest possible evaluation.

Come to think of it, Otto could probably also get the highest rating, but he occasionally reveals his ambitions out of nowhere, so he's one step below them. (laughs)
